name: firstpr
description: Find genuinely good open-source issues for your first PR — and build a job-seeking portfolio from it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @firstpr/api" "npm run dev -w @firstpr/worker" "npm run dev -w @firstpr/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @firstpr/api && npm run build -w @firstpr/worker && npm run build -w @firstpr/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @firstpr/api && npm run test -w @firstpr/github && npm run test -w @firstpr/scoring && npm run test -w @firstpr/web
